ambiguities.text: The specification states it 'extends' the Capella light client networking specification but does not restate the validation rules, leaving it unclear which Capella rules still apply.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all Capella light client P2P validation rules carry forward to Deneb unless explicitly overridden. The Deneb spec only adds the DENEB_FORK_VERSION type mappings.

ambiguities.text: No explicit error handling or peer scoring rules are defined for malformed light client messages.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard gossipsub and req/resp error handling applies: malformed messages are dropped, and repeated malformed messages may result in peer scoring penalties per the general P2P spec.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gossip network reliably delivers light client updates to subscribed light client nodes within a reasonable time bound.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Light clients could fall behind the chain head, miss finality updates, and be vulnerable to eclipse attacks where they only see stale data.

implicit_assumptions.description: At least one honest peer is available to respond to req/resp requests for bootstrap and update data.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A light client surrounded by malicious peers could be initialized with fraudulent bootstrap data or denied updates, preventing it from following the canonical chain.
